final_claim: For Kendall-tau codes in \(S_6\) of minimum distance at least \(10\), there are exactly \(3960\) labeled maximum four-word codes; every maximum is equidistant with all six distances \(10\), and the natural 1440-element relabeling/reversal action has four orbits of sizes \(360,720,1440,1440\).
limitations: The orbit claim uses the stated natural action, not a claim about the full abstract isometry group.
